name: Black Pearl (Color)
description: The Black Pearl is the protagonist ship in the movie "Pirates of the Caribbean" and is also the fastest ship in the Caribbean. The hull structure is exquisitely designed, and its streamlined hull and powerful power allow it to move forward quickly, allowing it to attack Port Royal without anyone noticing. It has powerful firepower and a legendary experience. It once had a head-on confrontation with the Dutchman, and also rescued Jack and others trapped in the sea at a critical moment. The special edition black pearl pirate ship metal puzzle has exquisite shape and rich colors, making it more valuable for viewing and collection!
